title: A protocol for lentiviral infection of primary patient pancreatic tumors
protocol: Euthanize tumor-bearing mouse.
Spray mouse and surgical tools with 70% Ethanol.
Remove pancreatic tumor and immediately place into ice cold RPMI 1640 (no additives).
In RPMI 1640 (no additives), dissect and discard necrotic tissue.
In 1 ml freshly prepared Miltenyi tissue dissociation media, finely mince tumor into 2-4 mm pieces.
Place minced tumor tissue into remaining 4 ml of dissociation medium in a gentleMACS C-tube.
Follow Miltenyi protocol 2.2.3 for the dissociation of tough tumors.
Re-suspend cells in culture media (RPMI 1640 media supplemented with 20% FBS, 1x non-essential amino acids, 100 IU/ml penicillin, 100 μg/ml streptomycin, 1x Glutamax).
Count single cells using a hemocytometer.
Dilute cells to a concentration of 2.5 x 10^5 cells per 200 ul of culture media.
Plate 200 ul of cells per well into an Ultra-Low attachment 24 well plate.
Add polybrene to each well for a final concentration of 5 ug/ml.
Add shRNA lentivirus at an MOI >10 (~25 ul virus per condition).
Culture cells for 24 hours at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
Collect cells after 24 hours and spin for 5 minutes at 300g.
Wash collected cells twice with culture media.
Suspend cells in 50 μl of RPMI 1640 media (no additives).
Stain 5 ul of uninfected/infected cells with anti-mouse EpCAM-PE antibody and analyze for GFP expression by flow cytometry on a FACSAria III machine.
Mix the remaining 45 ul of uninfected/infected cells with 45 ul of BD Matrigel Matrix Growth Factor Reduced.
Place the mixture on ice until transplantation.
Inject the cell mixture subcutaneously into the left or right flank of 5-8 week-old NOD/SCID Il2ry-/- (NSG) recipient mice.
Euthanize mice at 3 months post-transplant.
Collect and weigh tumors from euthanized mice.
Dissociate collected tumors as described above.
Stain tumor cells with anti-mouse EpCAM-PE antibody and analyze for GFP expression by flow cytometry on a FACSAria III machine.
Calculate the weight of EpCAM+;GFP+ tumor cells (g) using the formula: Tumor wet weight (g) x EpCAM+;GFP+ (%) = Weight EpCAM+;GFP+ tumor cells (g).
